assets.prompt: Cinematic 16:9 cover derived from the supplied 17th-century engraving, preserving the real likeness exactly: long wavy dark hair to the shoulders, narrow face, severe calm eyes, small plain white collar, dark coat. Scene: the man leans slightly forward across a dark table towards a single low candle flame in the left foreground, his face lit from below and the side in strong warm amber, hands folded and still, the rest of the room swallowed by brown-black darkness; a thin curl of smoke rises past his cheek. Candle is the only source; deep shadows, warm ochre highlights, cold darkness beyond, heavy film grain, shallow focus, painterly photorealism. Subject right of the candle, empty darkness on the right edge. Strictly no text, no letters, no numbers, no writing, no frame, no logo, no watermark, no halo, no cross or religious symbol, no other figures.
assets.reference_note: Real historical likeness only; the engraving itself is not embedded in the cover.

assets.prompt: Epic symbolic cinematic painting, 16:9 landscape. Interior of a vast ruined heathen temple at dawn: a colossal ancient idol statue, faceless and broken, lies toppled across the stone floor in dust and rubble, its head sheared off, one arm snapped. Behind it a bare empty pedestal; through the shattered roof a single shaft of hard morning light falls on the empty pedestal, not on the fallen idol. Dust motes drift in the beam, deep shadow everywhere else, faint amber rim light on the broken stone. Painterly baroque realism, monumental scale, muted palette of slate grey, dust ochre and cold blue. No human figures, no faces, no text, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no frame, no border.
